archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

mono.style: For dates, URLs, and reference codes

background.description: Bone White, mimics high-quality document paper.

surface.description: Pure white for high-contrast data areas.

primary.description: Deep Forest Green, authoritative, passport green.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Grid Borders (Technical)' strategy. Pure 1px solid borders. Do not use soft drop shadows. Cards should be flat rectangles with sharp or minimally rounded corners (max rounded-sm).
visual_enhancers.badges: Use pill shapes for 'Checked on [Date]' with mono font for the date. Prominent 'Sources' panel at the bottom.
visual_enhancers.warnings: Ambiguity/consult-a-professional banners should use the warning Rust color (#C85A32) with a stark solid background or thick border to stand out.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper grain/noise texture overlay on the background to enhance the 'official document' feel.

components.visa_lookup_form: Grid-based, structured like an official customs form. Inputs should have square or slightly rounded edges with clear bold labels.
components.checklist: Collapsible cards. When expanded, use a dense, technical list style. Custom checkboxes (stark squares, filled with Primary Green when checked).
components.sources_panel: A stark, technical footer or side panel detailing URLs and timestamps. Use mono font.
components.processing_cards: Data-heavy cards. Use large numeric typography for fee and time, with the source badge explicitly attached.

layouts.grid: Bento-style or strict technical grid. Mobile-first stacking.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding inside sections (p-8 or p-12), but tight data grouping within cards to resemble dense official documents.

motion.general: Minimalist. Snappy transitions. Accordion expansions should be smooth but fast. Hover states should darken the border or background slightly.

image_urls.hero_description: Clean, bright, structural airport terminal skylight. Use for hero or landing background.
image_urls.disclaimer_description: Close up of paper with passport stamps. Great for the first-use disclaimer screen.
image_urls.auth_description: Geometric world map line art. Good for auth screen side panel.

3d_libraries.recommendation: None needed. This app focuses on clear, 2D data presentation and trustworthiness. A 3D library would distract from the 'official document' feel.

icons.usage: Use crisp, well-defined icons for the 5-category checklist (Identity, Financial, Purpose-specific, Health/Biometric, Other).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not use generic fonts.
Implement pure flat surfaces with 1px borders (border-collapse style). Avoid box-shadows. The UI should look like a structured paper document.
For the 5-category checklist, use Shadcn Accordion but override the styles to be flat, with square corners and thick left borders when active.
Always ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements like the lookup form, checkboxes, and export buttons.
Implement the 'checked on [date]' source badges prominently inside the data cards.
The warning banner for 'consult-a-professional' must be highly visible, using the Warning Rust color (#C85A32).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through 1px borders and stark contrast rather than shadows (for this specific design).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (for this design, sharp corners or very slight rounding).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
